draft.subject: Re: Checking in on Orchard Works' setup
draft.body:
Hi Rosa,

Thanks for being straight with me — totally fair to take another week to decide whether Wrenfield is right for your team, and I won't crowd you in the meantime.

One thing that often helps the evaluation: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so seeing one real project in Wrenfield tends to answer the "is this us?" question faster than anything else.

If it's useful, I'm happy to set up that first project with you on a 15-minute call next week — just say the word and I'll work around your schedule.

Best,
Nadia
